# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"name": "read", "description": "Read a text file.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"filePath": {"type": "string"}, "limit": {"type": "integer"}}, "required": ["filePath"]}}
{"name": "list", "description": "List directory entries.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"dirPath": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["dirPath"]}}
</tools>
